title: Pointwise identity component for integral normalized ring refinement
statement: The integral normalized refinement comparison for an identity compactification becomes the identity on each object after applying the faithful integral coefficient inclusion.

proof.text: Specialize the normalized integral refinement pasting calculation to the identity refinement. The open-unit transpose, integral-left realization, and ringed clopen identity reduce the displayed mate to the identity on each integral object.

from.place: pointwise faithful-component decomposition of the identity clause

lean.statement:
theorem integral_normalized_ring_refinement_identity_component
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (R : CoefficientConstructionRing.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := f))
    (F : CoefficientConstructionFields.{u, v} l Ω D hl R)
    (M : CoefficientConstructionCommon.{u, v} l Ω D hl R F)
    (N : CoefficientConstructionRefinements.{u, v} l Ω D hl R F M)
    (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l) (c : Compactification f)
    (K : C.{u, v} l Ω X (.integral E)) :
    (RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω Y (.integral E)).map
        ((N.refinement (.id c) (.integral E)).left.hom.app K) = 𝟙 _
